deals.evidence: Billionaire Steven Rales has reached an agreement to purchase a 15% minority stake in the Indiana Pacers at a $3.47 billion valuation
deals.headline: Steven Rales to buy 15% of the Pacers at $3.47bn
deals.summary: Rales agreed to buy a further 15% at a $3.47bn valuation, taking him to 20%, pending NBA approval; the deal includes a possible path to future control, with management remaining under Simon family control. Inside Indiana Business, citing Forbes, puts his total outlay for the 20% at $525.5m.

deals.evidence: The agreement includes $360 million for capital improvements
deals.headline: CIB approves 25-year Pacers agreement with $360m fieldhouse upgrade
deals.investor: Capital Improvement Board of Managers / State of Indiana / Pacers Sports & Entertainment
deals.summary: The CIB approved a 25-year agreement including $360m of capital improvements: about $270m from state and CIB sources, $65m private investment from Pacers Sports & Entertainment and $25m from the City of Indianapolis.

ownership_summary: Controlled by the Simon family (Herbert Simon, owner and governor), which bought the team in 1983 for about $11 million and manages it through Pacers Sports & Entertainment. Billionaire Steven Rales (Danaher co-founder) owns 20%: an earlier, undisclosed 5% plus 15% agreed in November 2023 at a $3.47bn valuation, with a possible path to future control. Front Office Sports says the team will eventually pass to Herb's son Stephen Simon.
